name: University Hospital
summary: University Hospital has two tall stepped concrete patient blocks, lower side wings with long window bands, and a deep projecting entrance canopy.

evidence.note: regional-2m surface heights above inventory ground. Median 19.51 m, P90 53.33 m, highest return 56.10 m.
Original reference colour from a mean image patch centred at (174,99) on a 300 by 300 normalized grid in 62270869. Raw sRGB #b0a198. Joint colours and unit sizes estimated.
2025 London orthophoto. Sunlit roof patch at local [89.9, -155.5] averages #9d9885.
East approach shows low entrance block in front of tall recessed slabs, dark continuous strip windows and a tall nearly blind vertical core.
Deep square-ended concrete canopy over dark glazed entrance in the drive court. Canopy width and door position approximate.
Glazing wraps the inside corner of a three-level low wing below the higher block.
North drive separates the wing from the adjacent parking structure. The opposing garage decks are outside this footprint.
Ground-floor glazing below deep solid upper panels and a narrow dark strip.
LHSC identifies University Hospital and shows the original entrance and construction sequence.
Mean of a 7-pixel square at normalized (0.72,0.33) on the broad illuminated spandrel gives #c0b9af. The entrance extends across the setback immediately south of the concrete core.

The one-metre roof grid distinguishes the low drive canopy (4–5 m), the adjoining open forecourt (0–1 m), the concrete stair shaft (49 m) and the adjoining 45 m ward. The south-end slab samples mostly 41–42 m.

Northern longitudinal slab median 44.8 m, west podium 14.0 m, east podium 14.2 m. The dark oblique roof-image areas straddle the lower podiums and their cast shadows. The small western rooflight wing has 4.9–5.0 m returns.

notes: The two high blocks and the lower west, southeast and northwest roof plates follow the sampled surface. Ribbon windows turn the inside corners. The detached annex owns the connecting bridge. Bay counts on obscured faces and dimensions of openings are estimates. The eastern drive canopy is a suspended slab at 3.65–5.18 m. Its entrance glazing is recessed on the podium face about 5.4 m behind inventory wall 23. The open drive between the canopy and the separate tall stair shaft has ground-level lidar returns.
